pages.x: Carthage, a rich trading city in North Africa founded by Phoenicians, ruled the western Mediterranean by sea. Rome had just won all of Italy. In 264 BC they clashed over Sicily, and fought three wars over 120 years. The Romans called them Punic, from their word for Phoenician.

pages.t: Rome learns to fight at sea
pages.x: Rome had almost no warships. It copied a wrecked Carthaginian ship, trained rowers on benches on dry land, and added the corvus, a boarding bridge with an iron spike that hooked onto an enemy ship.
pages.fx: Sea battles became land battles, which the legions won. Rome won the first war in 241 BC and took Sicily, its first province overseas.

pages.x: In 218 BC Hannibal, a Carthaginian general in Spain, led an army with 37 war elephants over the Pyrenees and the Alps into Italy, losing much of it to snow, cold and mountain tribes. As a boy, it was said, he had sworn to his father never to be a friend of Rome.

At Cannae in 216 BC Hannibal let the Roman centre push deep into his line, then closed his wings around them. In one afternoon some 50,000 Romans died, perhaps the bloodiest single day of battle before modern times. Generals still study his trap.

Rome refused to make peace and avoided great battles in Italy. Its young general Scipio took Spain, then landed in Africa, and Carthage called Hannibal home. At Zama in 202 BC Scipio beat him, and Carthage gave up its empire and its fleet.

Carthage grew rich again. In Rome the old senator Cato ended every speech, whatever its subject, with the words "Carthage must be destroyed", and once held up fresh figs to the Senate, picked in Carthage only three days' sail away.

In 146 BC, after a three-year siege, Rome stormed Carthage, burned it for days and sold the survivors into slavery. The story that the Romans sowed its fields with salt was made up many centuries later.

Victory over Carthage made Rome master of the Mediterranean and set it on the road to empire. Hannibal lost, but became the model of the brilliant general, and his trap at Cannae has been copied on battlefields ever since.
